name: Rate Performance
description: Analyze electrochemical rate performance with the original TMCCDB browser workflows for model fitting, comparison, thickness scaling, characteristic time, transport and energy/power calculations.
features: Browser-local rate model fitting and model comparison
Thickness kinetics, characteristic time and transport limitation workspaces
Chronoamperometry rate reconstruction and energy/power analysis
Original model equations, validation, examples, references and exports retained

history.notes: Added the TMCCDB Rate Performance workspaces to AimatraLab with their original analysis models and scientific workflows.
